evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
Game Type: 6x3->7 Video Slot
Paylines: 729-117649 Bet Ways
RTP (%): Variant 1: 96.10 | Variant 2: 94.09
Max win; x Bet: 15000x
Bonus Features: Free Spins Bonus, Super Free Spins Bonus
Special Symbols: Wild, Bonus Symbol
Volatility (variance): Medium-High
Game URL: "https://sands-of-eternity-2.slotmill.com"
Sands of Eternity 2 is an enthralling Egyptian-themed avalanche slot featuring 6 reels and 7 rows, with up to 117,649 bet ways. The game starts with a unique 6 x 3 symbol grid arranged in a jigsaw pattern, offering 729 initial bet ways. Winning symbols and adjacent blockers are removed, allowing new symbols to cascade down in an avalanche motion, creating new win opportunities and increasing the number of bet ways.

In the base game, a random Expansion feature can activate, increasing the number of bet ways even further. Landing three bonus symbols awards 8 Free Spins, during which there is a chance to trigger Super Mode, boosting the win multiplier with every win.
